outro.line: Save this for the night before

beats.text: Claude, my exam is at eight, and I haven't read the forty pages.
I made eye contact with it.
Can you just summarize it for me?
Reading a summary feels like studying. It isn't.
Upload the file, and ask me for the ten ideas most likely to be on the exam.

panel.title: Find the ten that matter
panel.html:
BIO201.pdf The 10 ideas most likely to be on the exam, with page numbers.
1. Active vs passive transport p.42. ATP synthesis p.123. Enzyme inhibition p.194. Osmosis and tonicity p.7

beats.text: You have one night. Ten is plenty.
Now explain each idea back to me, in your own words.

panel.title: One page. Only your mistakes.
panel.html:

Competitive inhibition: binds the active site.

Hypertonic: water leaves the cell.

ATP synthase: runs on the proton gradient.
